entities.name: Public Execution as Social Event
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Public hangings drew crowds of thousands. London's Tyburn Tree executions were holidays — vendors sold food, pamphleteers hawked "last confessions," pickpockets worked the crowd. Drawings and quarterings were elaborate theatrical events. The condemned were expected to give a speech and die bravely.
